issues_in: data.json lacks `last_refreshed` and `verified` keys that sibling 2026-08-11-refreshed entries carry (e.g. dc/usdc-0098-cyrusone-aurora-data-center/data.json has "last_refreshed":
fixed: Added top-level "last_refreshed": "2026-08-11" to data.json (matches the 2026-08-11 refresh date used by all 15 sibling refreshed entries, incl. usdc-0098).

Added top-level "verified": true to data.json, consistent with NOTES.md 2026-08-11 posture (owner, land-sale approval, local-process/incomplete-application status, and absence of verified MW/construction evidence are verified) and with sibling convention (usdc-0029/usdc-0119 set verified true when the stated facts are sourced and unverified stages are not claimed).

Added "verification_notes" mirroring the NOTES.md 2026-08-11 statement: verified true for the sourced facts; verified false for full buildout scope reconciliation and any MW/capacity inference because official submittal PDFs were listed by the county but not fully extractable in this refresh.
Validated data.json parses as JSON (python3 json.load OK) after the edit.
remaining_risks: Top-level verified=true is a summary flag; the mixed posture (false for buildout-scope reconciliation and MW inference) is carried in verification_notes, matching sibling usdc-0029/usdc-0119 convention. No source URLs were re-verified in this pass because the issue was schema/flag completeness only.
SKILL.md not modified: issue did not require it (no schema drift observed; SKILL.md field list already covers status_as_of_cutoff/evidence_grade).
summary: Fixed the single review issue for usdc-0186 by adding the missing sibling-convention keys to data.json: last_refreshed (2026-08-11), verified (true), and verification_notes mirroring NOTES.md's documented verification posture. data.json revalidated as parseable JSON; no other files changed.
